description: This file defines Maltese (mt-MT) culture-specific settings for a date handling library, including date formats, month & day names, regex patterns, and date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date instance with the same time.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if the given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
